pages.title: Foliot Lumberjack
pages.text: The lumberjack will harvest trees in it's working area.$(br) If a deposit location is set it will collect the dropped$(br) items into the specified chest, and re-plant saplings.$(br)

pages.title: Prerequisites
pages.text: Summoning the lumberjack requires a $(item)Stable Otherworld Sapling$(). You can obtain it by summoning an $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_otherworld_sapling_trader)Otherworld Sapling Trader$(/l).$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the lumberjack.$(br2) $(br) See Books of Calling for more information.$(br)

pages.title: Lazy Lumberjack?
pages.text: The spirit might pause for a few minutes after clearing his work area,$(br)   even if trees have regrown since. This is a performance-saving$(br)   measure and not a bug, he will continue on his own.$(br2)  $()

pages.title: Lazy Lumberjack?
pages.text: $(br)  Set the work area again to make him continue work immediately.$(br)
